title: Generalised Gauss--Kuzmin Distribution for Klein sails in $\mathbb R^3$
summary: The classical Gauss--Kuzmin distribution describes the asymptotic distribution of continued fraction digits. Geometrically, this may be interpreted as the equidistribution of faces of Klein sails in $\mathbb R^2$. In this paper, we establish a three-dimensional analogue of this phenomenon. We prove the equidistribution of local face structures in generic Klein sails in $\mathbb R^3$, thereby obtaining a higher-dimensional generalization of the Gauss--Kuzmin distribution.
